regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, keywords, and SI availability sentence

The Pd(PPh3)4/K2CO3/DMSO/70 °C carbonate-plus-carbon-nucleophile allene reaction is explicitly previous work (reference 8), not a current-paper experiment.

The 1.0 mmol 1a, 1.2 equiv 2a, Pd(PPh3)4 5 mol%, K2CO3 3 equiv, DMSO, 70 °C/12 h experiment continues as Equation 1 on page 2 and its detailed procedure on page 6; all three locations are merged into one two-product record.

The narrative introduces Table 1 entries 1–7 and maps ligand/solvent/water effects to the row records on page 3; no duplicate prose-only experiments were created.

regions.finding: Figure 1 is X-ray characterization of Table 2 product 3e, not another synthesis. The two optically active substrate experiments continue as Scheme 4 on pages 4–5.
